text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t-e-d a s-h-a-d-o-w e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t f-l-o-w and l-e-f-t a f-a-l-s-e b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c s-e-g-m-e-n-t in the s-t-o-r-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y s-c-a-n.
2) the actor c-o-p-i-e-d the p-l-a-i-n t-e-x-t l-o-g s-t-r-e-a-m to a l-o-c-a-l d-i-s-k and l-e-f-t a c-l-o-n-e-d a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e behind while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-m-m-u-t-a-b-i-l-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k.
3) the actor m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-e-d the a-d-d-r-e-s s-p-a-c-e of the r-e-a-d-o-n-l-y v-o-l-u-m-e and l-e-f-t a m-i-s-l-a-b-e-l-e-d s-t-a-t-u-s f-l-a-g in the n-e-t-w-o-r-k while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-r-o-d-u-c-e-d s-t-a-t-u-s c-h-e-c-k.
4) the actor c-o-p-i-e-d the p-r-o-x-y m-a-p to a s-c-r-a-t-c-h p-a-r-t-i-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t a s-p-a-r-e e-n-t-r-y p-o-i-n-t o-p-e-n in the g-a-t-e-way while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-o-r-i-t-y r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) the actor d-i-s-a-b-l-e-d the a-l-e-r-t t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d for the s-e-s-s-i-o-n l-i-f-e-c-y-c-l-e and l-e-f-t a s-i-l-e-n-c-e-d m-o-n-i-t-o-r l-o-g behind while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-n-a-l i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
